description: pkix-lint/tests/cabf_tls_br_tests.rs:176-220 — The tests for SC-081's 100-day (2027-03-15) and 47-day (2029-03-15) phases only call sc081_validity_cap() directly — they do not exercise ValidityMaxLint with real DER fixtures. Comments note fixtures are missing and the tests were intentionally reduced. This means ValidityMaxLint is not end-to-end tested for the post-2027 and post-2029 phases. The 100d/47d fixture generation commands are provided in comments but the fixtures are not committed. Fix: generate and commit the missing fixtures (leaf-p256-110d-post-sc081-100d.der, leaf-p256-50d-post-sc081-47d.der) and add full lint-level tests using load_cert!().
title: cabf_tls_br tests for 100d and 47d SC-081 phases are cap-function only
